mission: Rank eligible Shanghai/Shenzhen A-shares at 14:25, enter only the fixed one-minute bar ending 14:56, and exit at the first later legal open.

clock.signal_timestamp: 14:25:00 after the bar ending 14:25 is complete
clock.entry_interpretation: one-minute VWAP of the bar ending 14:56, representing an order released just after 14:55; no earlier or later entry clock is compared
clock.entry_price: raw unadjusted amount/volume of the 14:56 bar
clock.exit: first legal raw open on a later market session; same-session sale is forbidden

universe.scope: historically identified Shanghai/Shenzhen common A-shares only; Beijing and unsupported identifiers are excluded
signal_requirements: current-day CY-008 execution window 0 hard_valid with available_at<=14:25 and bound daily_snapshot_id
current-day QD-004 minute grid complete from 09:30 through 14:25
trade_status=1 and is_st=false from the causal CY-008 window
QD-008 PIT industry known with notice_date<trade_date
no QD-010 new-risk blocker known by 14:25
all required lineage and snapshots exact
entry_requirements: 14:56 raw bar exists with finite positive OHLC, volume, and amount
entry VWAP is finite and positive
14:56 bar trades at least one cent below the registered upper limit; an upper-limit-pinned bar is unfilled
no suspension, unknown rule, action blocker, or hard-invalid execution state
unfilled Top-10 orders are not replaced

label.name: tail_to_first_legal_open_net_return
label.formula: (economic exit proceeds after sell cost)/(14:56 entry VWAP after buy cost)-1
label.cost_interpretation: canonical all-in repository convention including applicable commission/tax/slippage allowance
label.gross_diagnostic: economic exit proceeds before costs / entry VWAP - 1
label.severe_loss10: minimum cost-aware executable-coordinate low-mark return from entry through exit <= -0.10
label.price_limit_and_suspension: if the next session is suspended or sell_blocked_open, carry without fill to the first later legal open; unknown holding rows fail closed
label.corporate_actions: reuse ASHARE-CA-REPLAY-003 known_at/effective_date rules; block known new risk, carry exact supported cash-only actions, require pre-effective risk exit for share/rights events, and fail closed on unresolved terms

chronology.contamination_note: 2018-2023 broad-market outcomes are consumed development evidence; post-2023 broad-market security outcomes remain unread. Only calendar/schema metadata may be inspected before Stage C.
chronology.purge: for every prediction block, remove every training sample whose actual legal exit date is on or after the first prediction date
chronology.embargo: also remove the final signal session immediately before each prediction block even when its exit is earlier; no training sample may cross the overnight boundary into prediction time

ridge.preprocessing: training-fold median imputation then training-fold StandardScaler; no parameter is fit on prediction rows

models.early_stopping: inside each training span only: the final 126 training sessions form an inner chronological early-stopping block after purge; refit on the full outer training span using the selected iteration count
models.profile_selection: highest mean daily Spearman IC across 2020/2021 walk-forward predictions; differences <=0.001 break toward lower complexity, then higher Top-10 net mean

portfolio.weighting: equal target capital across the frozen Top-10; 100-share lots rounded down
portfolio.cash_rule: exits are processed before same-day tail entries; delayed holdings remain in the ledger and only free cash may fund new lots

all_required: selected LightGBM mean daily rank IC > 0
2020 and 2021 annual rank IC are each >= 0
selected LightGBM Top-10 mean net return > 0
selected LightGBM Top-10 net return exceeds eligible-universe net return
2022 and 2023 annual rank IC are each >= 0
LightGBM mean daily rank IC exceeds Ridge by >= 0.005
LightGBM mean daily rank IC exceeds the best simple rank baseline by >= 0.005
LightGBM Top-10 mean net return exceeds eligible-universe, Ridge, and best simple baseline by >= 0.0005 per decision date
LightGBM Top-10 mean net return is >= 0 in both 2022 and 2023
no single security, industry, or ten decision dates provide a majority of cumulative positive trade PnL
validation_continuation_gate.failure_action: classify using the frozen ML failure vocabulary and do not open final OOS

final_oos_governance.opening_condition: Stage B passes every validation continuation gate and a separate machine-readable Stage C freeze artifact is committed

resource_contract.source_scan: one raw QD-004 year at a time, one reader, projected 1.49 billion pre-2024 rows, column- and time-pruned through 14:56
resource_contract.development_materialization: 2018-2023 only during Stage B; 2024-2026 shards are forbidden before Stage C
resource_contract.git_policy: only code, specs, hashes, compact metrics/reports/manifests; no large panels or model matrices
